summary: Creating a Slack app and connecting it to your own workspace is self-serve, takes minutes, and has no Slack review. Turning on public distribution to other workspaces also has no review, but since May 29, 2025 new non-Marketplace distributed apps (and new installs of existing ones) are limited to 1 request per minute and 15 messages per call on conversations.history and conversations.replies. That limit breaks most AI agents that read message history, and Slack's updated API terms say the Marketplace is the only appropriate channel for commercial distribution. A Marketplace listing removes the limit, but you need 10 active workspace installs before you can submit, a public landing page, support page and privacy policy, and Slack says the review can take up to 10 business days plus up to 10 weeks.

artifacts.title: Slack app manifest (YAML, for Composio)
artifacts.content:
Paste into **api.slack.com/apps > Create New App > From a manifest**. Replace the redirect URL with Composio's callback URL, and make the scopes match what your Composio auth config requests.

```yaml
display_information:
  name: Acme Agent
  description: AI agent that answers questions and takes actions in Slack.
  background_color: "#1f2937"
features:
  bot_user:
    display_name: Acme Agent
    always_online: true
oauth_config:
  redirect_urls:
    - https://REPLACE-WITH-COMPOSIO-CALLBACK-URL
  scopes:
    bot:
      - app_mentions:read
      - chat:write
      - channels:read
      - channels:history
      - groups:history
      - im:history
      - users:read
    user:
      - search:read   # remove for a Marketplace submission
settings:
  org_deploy_enabled: false
  socket_mode_enabled: false
  token_rotation_enabled: false
```

Notes:
- `token_rotation_enabled: false` keeps bot tokens long-lived. Turn it on only if Composio refreshes Slack tokens for you (see open questions).
- Set `org_deploy_enabled: true` only if you need org-wide installs in an Enterprise org. Changing it later needs a reinstall.

artifacts.title: Scope reasons and admin-approval note (draft)
artifacts.content:
Use this for the Marketplace scope reasons and for customers' workspace admins.

| Scope | Token | How Acme Agent uses it |
|---|---|---|
| app_mentions:read | bot | Receives a message when someone @mentions Acme Agent so it can answer in that thread. |
| chat:write | bot | Posts the agent's answer as a threaded reply in the conversation where it was asked. |
| users:read | bot | Turns user IDs in a thread into display names so answers address people correctly. |
| channels:history | bot | Reads only the thread the user @mentioned the agent in, to understand the question. It does not read other channels and does not join channels on its own. |
| im:history | bot | Reads the user's direct message to the agent so it can reply. |

Data handling: message text is processed in memory to produce a reply and is not stored. We keep only message IDs and timestamps for 30 days for debugging. Slack data is never used to train models. Model: <vendor/model>. Data residency: <region>.

(Placeholders in angle brackets must be confirmed by a human before submitting.)

artifacts.title: Marketplace listing copy (draft)
artifacts.content:
**Short description (10 words or fewer):** Ask questions and get work done without leaving Slack.

**Long description:**
Acme Agent brings your Acme workspace into Slack. @mention it in any channel it has been invited to, or DM it, to:
- summarize the thread you are in
- look up Acme records and post them in the conversation
- create Acme tasks from a message

How it works in Slack: invite @Acme Agent to a channel, then @mention it. It only reads the thread you mention it in.

AI disclaimer: Acme Agent uses a large language model and may produce inaccurate responses or summaries. Check important information before acting on it.

Privacy: see https://acme.example/privacy. Support: support@acme.example (we reply within 2 business days).

**Test instructions for reviewers:** 1) Open https://acme.example/slack and click Add to Slack. 2) Sign in with the test account below (dummy data). 3) In any channel, type /invite @Acme Agent, then '@Acme Agent summarize this thread'. 4) Uninstall from Settings > Manage apps.
